# Community code of conduct

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.vi.md)

We aim to keep this project welcoming, technical and constructive.

Contributors should discuss evidence and code respectfully, accept
well-supported technical criticism, credit upstream authors, and protect
private information. Harassment, discriminatory abuse, personal attacks,
impersonation and publishing another person's secrets are not accepted.

Maintainers may edit, lock or remove inappropriate content and restrict
participation where necessary. Please report conduct concerns privately to
**Đăng Khoa <i.am@dangkhoa.dev>** with relevant context. Do not post personal
details or abuse reports publicly.
